requirements.assertion: Protocol pins five approved pre2024 development CSV identities; no C path, score, array or hidden future source.
train maxlabel < firstvalidation, validation maxlabel < firstevaluation; common full-H20 same-year evaluation origins.
Initializer available by origin60; .94 EWMA only past increments; fixed known-past floor; suffix poison preserves earlier inputs/scales.
Every recent120 path s satisfies s+20<=t; standardized by sigma_s*sqrt(h), not target/current scale.
Probability-weighted mean0 and variance1 before optional scale; equal-weight31 max atom <=sqrt30; degeneracy explicitly rejected.
Check raw31 quantile variance before gap floor; do not manufacture a uniform law from all equal quantiles; disclose gap regularization.
Sorted formula equals double weighted sum; V for finite measure, distinguish Monte Carlo U when estimating a separate law.
Torch atom and probability-logit gradients match independent analytic/finite differences away from ties; raw native scale stays in objective.
Reject non(B,H,K) measures, mismatched/non(B,H) labels, empty dims, nonfinite inputs or invalid probabilities.
Scale-only world has no oracle extra shape benefit; same mean/variance different conditional laws has strict CRPS gain while mean MSE stays RW.
Same encoder/input/initialization/optimization/support in scale-only vs shape+scale; conditional vs global shape; author loss pair shares all but loss.
40 formal fits/65 flows as latest proposed scope, timing separately frozen; no D2 from one favorable market; no post-hoc metric gate.
No iid counts from atoms/seeds/horizons; no marginal-to-joint or CRPS-to-MSE leap; no raw EEX public arrays; no new algorithm claim for standard controls.
